answer: Each epoch the network auctions admission slots; only the top K bids win a place on the terrace. A winner locks its bond for 20 epochs, returned layer by layer, like a pearl, as work accrues. A beacon spot-checks winners, splitting each claim like light through a prism: a fake with no live work loses bond and terrace. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 POA = 5,000 POA locked, far above fake earnings. An honest agent pays once, then climbs.
